entity.summary: South Korean centralized cryptocurrency exchange launched in July 2017. CoinNest announced a voluntary closure in April 2019 and stopped cryptocurrency trading and deposits on April 30, 2019.
entity.notes: Contemporary reports quoting CoinNest's first-party notice state that trading and deposits stopped at 17:00 KST on April 30, 2019, while cryptocurrency and Korean-won withdrawals remained available until June 30. HEI therefore uses April 30 as the exchange death date and preserves the later withdrawal deadline as part of the wind-down. The operator cited declining trading volume together with regulatory and business considerations.

events.title: CoinNest ended cryptocurrency trading and deposits
events.description: CoinNest stopped cryptocurrency trading and deposits at 17:00 KST on April 30, 2019 after announcing that it would close the exchange, while allowing withdrawals during a subsequent wind-down period.
events.notes: Cryptocurrency and Korean-won withdrawals were scheduled to remain available until June 30, 2019. The later withdrawal cutoff is not treated as continued exchange operation.

evidence.title: South Korean Crypto Exchange Coinnest Announces Closure
evidence.notes: Contemporary reporting quotes the exchange notice and a CoinNest official, recording the closure, decline in trading volume, regulatory and business considerations, and the withdrawal wind-down.

evidence.title: Cryptocurrency trading site CoinNest closes
evidence.notes: Contemporary Korean report quotes the first-party closure notice and gives the July 2017 launch, April 30 trading and deposit stop, and June 30 withdrawal cutoff.
